title: Chicken Lime Wrap
description: A quick and flavorful wrap filled with grilled chicken, fresh lime, and crispy lettuce. Perfect for a weeknight dinner!
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Grill chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let chicken rest for 2-3 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm the wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the lime juice mixture on the wrap, then topping with sliced chicken, shredded lettuce, and a sprinkle of cilantro.
